AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 81 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7776, #7779, #7781, #7788 and #7790:

- #7776 → #5468: `audit:complete` (plan-aware Turso quota denominators; stale Starter-cap artifact corrected).
- #7779 → #5820: `audit:complete` (client-surface parity design).
- #7781 → #5683: `audit:partial` (step-1 framework skeleton; remaining work is tracked in #5876–#5883 and #7782–#7787).
- #7788 → #6032: `audit:completed-later` via #11243, which builds and installs the watchdog core.
- #7790 → #7789: `audit:complete` (provider-retirement suite is now wired into scripts-test and registered).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later-PR evidence, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7776-7790/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7776-7790.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 81 valid PRs audited from 85 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 165 identifiers remain, next #7792. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
